schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts of all landholding farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria).
schemes.benefit: Rs. 6,000 / year direct benefit transfer (DBT)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against yield loss due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pest, cyclone).
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including loanee and non-loanee farmers.
schemes.benefit: Subsidized premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for annual horticultural crops.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.description: Timely and adequate credit support to farmers for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and maintenance of farm assets.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers, individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.
schemes.benefit: Credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at effective 4% p.a. interest rate with prompt repayment incentive.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.description: Subsidies for purchase of agricultural machinery and establishment of Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) to increase farm power availability.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, Cooperatives, and Rural Entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefit: 40% to 50% subsidy on tractors, harvesters, laser levelers, rotavators, and sprayers.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
schemes.title: PM-KUSUM Solar Agricultural Pumps
schemes.description: Installation of standalone solar agriculture pumps and solarization of existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, Water User Associations, and FPOs in off-grid or grid-connected areas.
schemes.benefit: Up to 60% capital subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Govt) with 30% bank loan.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Organic Farming
schemes.description: Promotion of commercial organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers forming a cluster of 50 or more farmers with 50 acres of contiguous land.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 50,000 per hectare over 3 years (Rs. 31,000 for organic inputs via DBT).

schemes.name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)
schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
schemes.description: Subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to maximize water use efficiency and farm productivity.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmers with assured irrigation source.
schemes.benefit: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation systems.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.description: Medium-long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
schemes.eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperatives, FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups.
schemes.benefit: 3% interest subvention per annum up to Rs. 2 Crore for maximum period of 7 years.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.title: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
schemes.description: Periodic soil testing and issuance of customized Soil Health Cards recommending crop-wise nutrient dosages.
schemes.eligibility: All farm landholdings in India.
schemes.benefit: Free comprehensive soil nutrient analysis (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC).

schemes.name: UP Paradarshi Kisan Seva Yojana
schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Paradarshi Kisan Seva Yojana
schemes.description: Single-window direct benefit transfer for seed subsidies, agricultural implements, solar pumps, and vermicompost units in UP.
schemes.eligibility: Registered farmers on UP Agriculture portal with Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
schemes.benefit: 40% to 50% direct subsidy credited to bank account for certified seeds and equipment.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (MP)
schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
schemes.description: State top-up scheme supplementing PM-KISAN, providing an additional Rs. 6,000 annually to registered MP farmers.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in Madhya Pradesh eligible for and receiving PM-KISAN benefits.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year in three installments (making total annual income support Rs. 12,000).

schemes.name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana (MP)
schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana (Price Deficit Financing)
schemes.description: Compensates farmers for the price gap between MSP and the actual lower modal sale price in mandis for oilseeds and pulses.
schemes.eligibility: Registered farmers selling notified crops in MP APMC mandis during notified procurement season.
schemes.benefit: Direct cash compensation for price difference up to MSP.

schemes.name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana (BBY Haryana)
schemes.title: Haryana Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana (Horticulture Price Deficit)
schemes.description: Guarantees benchmark base prices for vegetable and fruit crops (potato, tomato, onion, cauliflower, peas, etc.) protecting from market crash.
schemes.eligibility: Horticultural farmers registered on the Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal.
schemes.benefit: Deficit payout if market wholesale price falls below benchmark cost.

schemes.name: Mera Pani Meri Virasat (Haryana)
schemes.title: Mera Pani Meri Virasat (Water Conservation Scheme)
schemes.description: Incentive for farmers shifting land from water-guzzling paddy to maize, pulses, cotton, or agroforestry.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in groundwater over-exploited blocks who replace paddy cultivation.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 7,000 per acre financial incentive directly transferred.

schemes.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (Maharashtra)
schemes.title: Maharashtra Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.description: Maharashtra state top-up providing Rs. 6,000 annually in addition to the Central PM-KISAN scheme.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmers eligible for PM-KISAN in Maharashtra.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 6,000 / year (combined Rs. 12,000 with PM-KISAN).

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana (Rajasthan)
schemes.title: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana
schemes.description: Monthly electricity bill subsidy for metered agricultural power consumers in Rajasthan.
schemes.eligibility: Metered agricultural electricity consumers in Rajasthan with non-defaulter status.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs. 1,000 per month (max Rs. 12,000 per year) subsidy credited directly against farm power bill.

schemes.name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh YSR Rythu Bharosa
schemes.description: Annual financial assistance to farmer families including tenant farmers and forest land cultivators.
schemes.eligibility: Landowner farmer families, tenant farmers (CCRC holders), and RoFR tribal cultivators in AP.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 13,500 per year per farmer family in 3 installments.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu & Rythu Bima (Telangana)
schemes.title: Telangana Rythu Bandhu / Rythu Bharosa
schemes.description: Direct investment support for agriculture inputs (seeds, fertilizers, field prep) per acre per season, plus comprehensive farmer life insurance.
schemes.eligibility: Pattadar passbook holders and recorded landholding farmers in Telangana.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 7,500 per acre per season (Rs. 10,000-15,000/year) + Rs. 5 Lakh Rythu Bima life cover.

schemes.name: Krishak Bandhu (West Bengal)
schemes.title: West Bengal Krishak Bandhu (Natun)
schemes.description: Financial support for agricultural activities and death benefit insurance for farmers and sharecroppers in West Bengal.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers and recorded bargadars (sharecroppers) aged 18-60 years in West Bengal.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 10,000 per year (for 1+ acre) in two installments + Rs. 2 Lakh life insurance grant.

schemes.name: Raitha Siri & Krishi Bhagya (Karnataka)
schemes.title: Karnataka Raitha Siri & Krishi Bhagya Scheme
schemes.description: Promotion of millet cultivation and construction of farm ponds, polythene lining, and diesel pumpsets in rainfed areas.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating minor millets (ragi, foxtail, little millet) or farming in rainfed taluks.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 10,000 per hectare incentive for millet cultivation; up to 80-90% subsidy on farm ponds.
